title: Salomlashish va o‘zingizni tanishtirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida salomlashasiz, ismingiz va qayerdan ekaningizni aytasiz hamda suhbatdoshingizga savol berasiz.
homework_uz: 30 soniyalik tanishtiruv yozib oling: salom, ismingiz, mamlakatingiz va suhbatdoshga ikkita savol. Keyin shu tanishtiruvni 4 gapda yozing. Har bir gapda I am yoki I'm shakli to‘g‘ri ishlatilganini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Birinchi suhbat — to‘rtta oddiy qadam
scenes.say: Welcome to your first conversation lesson. Today you will learn to say hello, give your name, and say where you are from. Listen to each example. Then say it aloud. You do not need to speak quickly. Clear, simple sentences are enough.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi suhbat darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun salomlashish, ismingizni va qayerdan ekaningizni aytishni o‘rganasiz. Har bir misolni tinglab, ovoz chiqarib takrorlang. Tez gapirish shart emas: sodda va aniq gaplar yetarli.

scenes.title: Vaziyatga mos salomlashish
scenes.say: Hello works in most situations. Hi is more informal, so use it with friends. In the morning, say good morning. When you meet someone in the evening, say good evening. Good night is different. We usually say it when leaving at night or going to bed.
scenes.say_uz: Hello ko‘p vaziyatlarda mos keladi. Hi norasmiyroq, uni do‘stlar bilan ishlating. Ertalab Good morning, kechqurun uchrashganda Good evening deng. Good night esa odatda kechasi xayrlashganda yoki uxlashdan oldin aytiladi.

scenes.title: Ismingizni ayting
scenes.say: There are two useful ways to introduce yourself. My name is Aziza. Or, I am Aziza. In conversation, I am often becomes I'm. Listen: I'm Daniel. Both forms are correct. Now use your own name. My name is. I'm.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni ikki usulda tanishtirishingiz mumkin: My name is Aziza yoki I am Aziza. Suhbatda I am ko‘pincha I'm shaklida qisqaradi. Har ikki shakl to‘g‘ri. Endi o‘z ismingiz bilan takrorlang.

scenes.title: Qayerdan ekaningizni ayting
scenes.say: To say where you are from, use I am from, then a country or a city. I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm from Tashkent. To ask the other person, say: Where are you from? Listen to the whole exchange. Where are you from? I'm from Uzbekistan. And you?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerdan ekaningizni aytish uchun I am from dan keyin mamlakat yoki shahar nomini qo‘ying. I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm from Tashkent. Suhbatdoshga Where are you from? deb savol bering. And you? — Siz-chi? degani.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang

examples.t: What is your name? → What's your name?
examples.uz: Ismingiz nima? — to‘liq va qisqa shakl

scenes.say: Here is a common mistake. I from Uzbekistan. A word is missing. Say: I am from Uzbekistan. English needs am in this sentence. In speech, I'm from Uzbekistan is natural. Keep am even when you speak quickly. Now listen to the question: What's your name?
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p uchraydigan xato: I from Uzbekistan. Bu gapda am yetishmayapti. To‘g‘risi: I am from Uzbekistan yoki I'm from Uzbekistan. O‘zbekchadagi Men O‘zbekistondanman gapini so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang: inglizchada am kerak.

scenes.title: Qisqa suhbatni tinglang
board: A: Hello! I'm Daniel. What's your name?
B: Hi! My name is Aziza.
A: Nice to meet you. Where are you from?
B: I'm from Uzbekistan. And you?
scenes.say: Listen to a short conversation. Hello! I'm Daniel. What's your name? Hi! My name is Aziza. Nice to meet you, Aziza. Where are you from? I'm from Uzbekistan. And you? I'm from Canada. Nice to meet you too.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa suhbatni tinglang. Salom, men Danielman. Ismingiz nima? Salom, mening ismim Aziza. Tanishganimdan xursandman, Aziza. Qayerdansiz? Men O‘zbekistondanman. Siz-chi? Men Kanadadanman. Men ham tanishganimdan xursandman.

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz: uchta gap ayting
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Say hello. Tell me your name. Say where you are from. Then ask me my name. Use the sentences on the screen if you need help. Say your answer aloud during the pause.
scenes.say_uz: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Salomlashing, ismingizni va qayerdan ekaningizni ayting. Keyin ismimni so‘rang. Kerak bo‘lsa ekrandagi gaplardan foydalaning. Pauza paytida javobingizni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob va tekshiruv
scenes.say: Here is one possible answer. Hello! My name is Aziza. I'm from Uzbekistan. What's your name? Check your answer. Did you include am in I'm from? Did you ask a question? Your name and country can be different. The sentence pattern stays the same.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob: Hello! My name is Aziza. I'm from Uzbekistan. What's your name? O‘zingizni tekshiring: I'm from da am ni ishlatdingizmi? Savol berdingizmi? Ismingiz va mamlakatingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, gap qolipi esa bir xil.

scenes.title: Xayrlashing va yana bir marta mashq qiling
scenes.say: To finish, say goodbye, or see you later. You can now start a simple conversation. For homework, record a thirty-second introduction. Include a greeting, your name, your country, and two questions. Then write the same introduction. Practise slowly first. See you in the next lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Suhbatni Goodbye yoki See you later bilan yakunlang. Endi sodda suhbat boshlay olasiz. Uyga vazifa: 30 soniyalik tanishtiruv yozib oling. Unda salom, ism, mamlakat va ikkita savol bo‘lsin. So‘ng shu tanishtiruvni matn qilib yozing. Avval sekin mashq qiling.
